title: LLM isolation X19b: profiles hold neutral sandbox intents, the drivers translate them, and personas name no Claude-only tool
summary: All 93 agent profiles hold Claude tool syntax such as Bash(evolve phase verify:*) in allowed_tools, and disallowed_tools uses Edit(...) and Bash(git push:*) (.evolve/profiles/*.json). 27 profiles have extra_flags_by_cli with Claude Code flags (--strict-mcp-config, --plugin-dir). 14 of 106 persona files under agents/ name a Claude Code tool. Spec: docs/architecture/llm-isolation.md §28.
fix: Replace allowed_tools and disallowed_tools with neutral sandbox intents (read inputs, write worktree, run command class X, network) that each driver translates into its own syntax. Move extra_flags_by_cli into the manifests. Rewrite the 14 personas in neutral words. Shrink the X19a guard allowlist to drop each moved site. The instruction files (CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, .claude/agents) stay with X10; this item changes only the personas under agents/.
